# Chuck Blake

> Chuck Blake is a Brooklyn-based startup founder and fractional CTO who builds AI systems and developer tools. His current projects include Arwen, Glance (glnc.io), GetMusic.fm, and IndieCrates. He writes the newsletter In General and makes electronic music as Corvoco. Most recently he was CTO at LEA, building document-intelligence systems for enterprise wealth management.

This is the personal site of Chuck Blake (chuck.blake@gmail.com). It is server-rendered HTML built with Jekyll.

## Pages

- [About](https://chuckblake.com/): Bio, what he's building now, and how to get in touch.
- [Fractional CTO](https://chuckblake.com/fractional-cto/): Consulting on AI integration, technical architecture, and startup operations.
- [Writing & talks](https://chuckblake.com/publications/): Posts and presentations on AI systems, developer relations, and productivity.
- [Blog](https://chuckblake.com/blog/): Articles and notes.
- [Projects](https://chuckblake.com/projects/): Things he's built.
- [Music](https://chuckblake.com/music/): Electronic music made as Corvoco, and a listening log.

## Projects

- [Arwen](https://www.arwen.ai/): AI product work for high-volume social comment intelligence.
- [Glance](https://glnc.io): Expectation monitoring for automated work — scheduled checks, output expectations, alerts, and remediation work items for humans or AI agents.
- [GetMusic](https://getmusic.fm): Tools that help independent artists promote their music on Bandcamp.
- [IndieCrates](https://indiecrates.com): Shareable Bandcamp crates for scenes, releases, and independent-music communities.
